title: Upstream sync job: track main and open PR metadata read-only
objective: Upstream merges about 1000 commits per day to main (790 commits since 2026-11-24 per the commits API on 2026-11-25) and has 2666 open PRs.
description: Upstream merges about 1000 commits per day to main (790 commits since 2026-11-24 per the commits API on 2026-11-25) and has 2666 open PRs. Build a scheduled read-only fetch of main and of open PR metadata (number, title, author, labels, head SHA, Fixes/Unblocks/Depends lines) with gh api pagination, under a fixed call budget. No writes to upstream.
acceptance: Job uses only GET requests and records rate-limit usage per run
Output is a JSONL snapshot comparable across runs (new, closed, merged and label changes)
ORBIS main fast-forwards from upstream main without local divergence, or the divergence is reported
